summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: Version 8.0.5 of this Babel preset declares a `preinstall` script `node setup.mjs` that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a 727KB bundled file `math_init.js`. Both `setup.mjs` (obfuscator.io-style hex-suffixed identifiers with dispatch-object indirection) and `math_init.js` (string-array shuffler plus numeric alphabet table decoder) are heavily obfuscated. The declared purpose of the package is a Babel preset, whose 492-byte legitimate entry point has no need for a separate JS runtime or a 727KB opaque blob. This install-time chain executes attacker-controlled bytes on the installer's machine on every `npm install`, using a downloaded alternate runtime to evade Node-based scanning. Prior versions of the package are ordinary Babel preset code with no preinstall hook, consistent with a hijacked-publish incident on this specific version.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
